purpose_zh: 把五类城市设计检查转成同一套场地落位程序；它们是后台审计维度，不是公众需要记忆的层级系统。
purpose_en: Turns five urban-design traditions into one siting procedure; theory operates as a spatial gate to reduce, move, or cancel intervention.

layers.veto: Do not replace daily service with an AI event; repair ordinary life first.
Remove hierarchy if a first-time visitor cannot explain origin, destination and pause points in one minute.
Without measurements, default to less construction, reversibility and distance from root zones.
Repair ground and ground floors before architecture; screens and brands do not own the first visual layer.
Reject any component that cannot be tested alone, restored, and rewritten by another community.

boundary_note: This framework does not establish a statutory land-use, building, heritage, road, or engineering approval.
